title: Systems
description: Find and open every DVISION service in one place.

descriptionCount.one: Find and open the {count} DVISION service in one place.
descriptionCount.other: Find and open all {count} DVISION services in one place.

empty.title: No results
empty.hint: Try a different name or feature, or set the category to All.

admin.description: Saved changes appear right away on the hub and in every service's app switcher.
admin.listHint: Shown on the hub in this order. Deleting also removes the service from everyone's favorites and recent list and cannot be undone. To hide it for a while, use Hide instead.
admin.name: Name
admin.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Cannot be changed after adding.
admin.idLocked: Favorites are linked to this value, so it cannot be changed.
admin.idInvalid: Start with a lowercase letter or digit and use up to 50 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
admin.linksHint: The first link opens when the card is clicked. With two or more, all of them appear under the card.
admin.linksInvalid: Enter button text, and start each URL with http:// or https://.
admin.accessHint: Hiding a card is only guidance. Each service blocks access on its own.

accessType.client: Only people with the service role

admin.client: Client ID on the auth server
admin.emojiHint: Shown when there is no logo.
admin.logoHint: A file path under public/logos in the hub repository, or an https image URL.
admin.offsetHint: If the service has a bottom tab bar, use its height + 20. Leave empty for 20.
admin.hideHint: Removed from the list and the app switcher. Favorites and recent history stay.
